ITEM 1 | Cubed pieces, roughly 2-3 cm each, golden-brown to tan with crisp, browned, slightly uneven surfaces and some darker caramelized edges; matte to lightly glossy with oil sheen; firm, holding shape; clustered in a band on the right half of a white square plate, covering roughly 25-30% of the plate area and stacked two layers high in places | 165
ITEM 2 | Small white crumbly cheese-like pieces, one fragment resting on top of the potato cubes near their center, pale off-white, soft, slightly irregular edges; a few more crumbles on a separate plate at the left edge | 12
ITEM 3 | Whole round grapes, dark reddish-purple, glossy and smooth skin, about 1.5-2 cm diameter each, roughly 10-12 grapes in a loose cluster at the lower right of the potato pieces, firm and intact | 90
ITEM 4 | Watermelon pieces, bright pink-red flesh, juicy and moist-looking, cut into wedge/triangular chunks about 3-4 cm across and 1.5-2 cm thick, four to five pieces at the lower left of the grapes, sitting directly on the plate with slight surface sheen | 85
